title: Come / came / come
descriptionFa: فرق come و go، و عبارت‌های پرکاربرد با come.

words.example: Can you come to my house on Friday?
words.tipFa: come = به سمت اینجا (جایی که گوینده هست). go = از اینجا به اونجا.

words.example: My cousins came to see us last week.
Someone knocked on the door and I said, 'Come in!'
words.tipFa: با اسم: come into the room.

words.example: I waited for an hour, but she didn't come out of the shop.
words.tipFa: برای دستگاه هم هست: The ticket comes out of the machine.

words.example: When are you going to come back from Turkey?
words.tipFa: معمولاً با from: come back from Italy.

words.example: What time did you come home last night?
words.tipFa: بدون to: come home، نه come to home.

words.example: Where do you come from? I come from Iran.
words.tipFa: I come from Iran، نه I'm coming from Iran.

words.example: We're going to the cinema. Do you want to come along?
Come and see me when you're in Shiraz.
Come here, please. I want to show you something.
words.tipFa: بدون to: come here، نه come to here.
